steps.instruction: Write a first draft responding to the user's request. Prioritize getting the substance and structure right over polish — a complete rough draft beats a perfect fragment.

Review the draft above as a constructive skeptic. List its 3-5 most serious weaknesses in order of impact: unsupported claims, missing counter-arguments, structural problems, unclear passages. Quote the specific text each weakness refers to. Do not rewrite anything yet.
Produce the final version: revise the original draft to address each weakness identified in the review. Keep what was already working. Output only the finished piece.
